proves.claim: a wake touch given the PULLBOARD_HOME a local runner started under finds that runner and writes the wake file; one given no home does not

drive.local-wake.touch-finds-a-runner-un.why: The runner's state file is keyed to its home, so a touch that ignored the home never woke a runner the tour started and the wake marker was missing.

proves.claim: watchWake calls its idle callback when a nap begins to wait, so a runner can tell a caller it is ready for a touch

drive.local-wake.idle-is-called-as-a-nap.why: The tour offers its first job only once the demo runner is idle, because a touch that lands while the runner still loads is lost.
